- MISSING_INFO: location 2 has no year built [locations[2].year_built]. It is required for the appetite rules and was not found in any document [review_flags: locations[2].year_built].

**Account**

It has been in business 58 years [insured.years_in_business], with 144 employees [insured.employee_count]. This is new business [policy.transaction_type], effective 2027-01-01 [policy.effective_date]. The prior carrier is Great Plains Casualty [policy.prior_carrier] and the quote is needed by 2026-12-16 [policy.quote_needed_by]. Requested limits are building 4,055,000 [coverage.building_limit], BPP 900,000 [coverage.bpp_limit] and BI 400,000 [coverage.business_income_limit], on a broad form [coverage.cause_of_loss_form] with a 1,000 deductible [coverage.deductible].

**Loss history**

There are two closed claims: 2023 water damage, 13,540 incurred [claims[CL2872928].incurred], and 2024 equipment breakdown, 10,900 incurred [claims[GPC202410877].incurred]. Both have zero reserve [claims[CL2872928].reserve] [claims[GPC202410877].reserve].

**Needs attention**

- TIV conflict: one source shows 5,355,000 and another 4,497,000. The derived value, 5,355,000, was kept [totals.total_tiv].
